name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
purpose: Google Sheets service account identity; production presence unverified.

name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY
purpose: Sheets JWT signing; never expose in client or logs. Production presence unverified.

name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
purpose: Contact Maps Embed key; restrict by API and permitted referrers. Fallback works without it.

name: VITE_LOVABLE_CONNECTOR_GOOGLE_MAPS_BROWSER_KEY
purpose: Listing Maps Embed key; restrict by API/referrer. Query embed fallback provided.

name: VITE_LOVABLE_CONNECTOR_GOOGLE_MAPS_TRACKING_ID
purpose: Not referenced by application; not evidence of an analytics installation.

name: PHASE1_TEST_TOOLS
purpose: Path to temporary jsdom/esbuild audit tooling.

name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
purpose: Optional alternative to authenticated Wrangler session; correct account and scope required.

name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
purpose: Correct target account identifier; never infer from current login.
